_note: TWO-SUB (Codex + Grok): selected Codex or Grok intake dispatches when usable. Exactly one effective dispatcher is recorded per run; recorded exhaustion activates the configured fallback.

codex-cli.note: the user's selected Codex model may dispatch; the intake plan runs MCP volume and Sol review

grok-cli.note: may dispatch when selected; otherwise implements

rules.non_dispatcher_hosts: Grok drafts nothing — it implements the dispatched brief
rules.entry_is_free: type from Codex or Grok; the user assigned the single dispatcher to their Codex plan
rules.portability: adding a Claude seat later gives a second review family and new intake/profile/fallback choices
